hooks.description: Guard rail: if .gitignore is edited, verify that /.kiro is NOT ignored. Judges verify this project was built with Kiro by inspecting the committed /.kiro directory; ignoring it would silently destroy the submission's Implementation evidence.
hooks.name: kiro-guard

then.prompt: .gitignore was just edited. Check whether any new pattern would ignore files under /.kiro (specs, steering, hooks). If yes: revert that pattern immediately, restore the warning comment about .kiro, and clearly tell the user what you did and why. If .kiro is still fully tracked, simply confirm briefly that the guard check passed.
